name: Millefiori
source: The main character, Kojirou, is an average student. Rikana Millefiori, a friend of his who stopped going to school, suddenly calls him one day to arrange a meeting. From there, they start hanging out together.
translation: 主角小次郎是一名普通的学生。他的一位朋友瑞卡娜·米勒菲奥里 (Rikana Millefiori) 不再上学，有一天突然打电话给他安排一次会面。从那里开始，他们开始一起出去玩。
